verdict.rationale: Make provides a custom-apps framework (Base, Connections, Webhooks, Modules, RPCs) letting developers build their own integrations, which implies third-party apps could exist, but the evidence pack contains no mention of a public app marketplace, community app store, or a mechanism for installing apps built by other developers outside the vendor. missing for 10: evidence of a community/marketplace listing, an install flow for third-party apps, or vendor documentation of external contributors' apps being installable.
